programme.title: Champion du monde
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie essayent de battre le record du monde de l'émission du web la plus longue. Pour ce faire, iCarly doit durer plus de 24h d'affilée...

programme.title: Freddie a une copine
programme.desc: Une fan d'iCarly, Valerie, demande à Freddie de sortir avec elle. Leur relation se passe si bien que Freddie commence à filmer la propre émission de Valerie.

programme.title: Naissance dun artiste
programme.desc: Carly invite l'idole de Spencer, Harry Joyner, pour qu'il puisse admirer son œuvre. Quand Harry qualifie son travail d'amateur, Spencer a le sentiment que sa vie n'avait plus de but.

programme.title: La plus grande des fans
programme.desc: La plus grande fan d'iCarly, Mandy, est invitée sur le plateau de l'émission comme seul public. Mandy s'avèrera être plus une traqueuse qu'une fan, et les enfants vont vite vouloir s'en débarrasser...

programme.title: Poussins.com
programme.desc: Carly et Sam cherchent à féconder des poules pour leur projet de sciences. Mais les poules s'échappent de l'incubateur...

programme.title: Je ne veux pas dembrouilles
programme.desc: Carly fabrique pour Sam un unique T-shirt iCarly pour commémorer l'anniversaire de leur amitié. Mais quand Sam échange le t-shirt contre des billets de concert, les deux amies se disputent.

programme.title: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: Jai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: Mauvaise promotion
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités au QG de la marque de chaussures Daka, où on leur offre une belle somme d'argent pour essayer les nouvelles chaussures Daka, "Tech-foot", sur iCarly..

programme.title: La promesse
programme.desc: Carly obtient un B à un devoir d'Histoire pour lequel elle pensait avoir un A. Durant sa réunion hebdomadaire avec le principal Franklin, Sam change la note sur l'ordinateur et surprend Carly avec le A qu'elle mérite.

programme.title: On passe à la télé
programme.desc: Un producteur très influent veut transposer iCarly à la télévision. Mais Carly, Sam et Freddie sont vite décontenancés par les changements que le producteur veut opérer dans l'émission...

programme.title: Un petit ami très envahissant
programme.desc: Sam se trouve un petit ami, et ces deux là sont inséparables. Mais quand leur relation se met à interférer avec iCarly, Carly et Freddie savent qu'ils doivent intervenir.

programme.title: Les videos pirates
programme.desc: Après avoir regardé un extrait d'iCarly qui montre un homme vendre des copies illégales de films, deux détectives décident de se servir de Carly et Spencer pour leur enquête.

programme.title: Compulsion
programme.desc: Amy, est une chef cuisinière qui rêve d'avoir son propre show télévisé culinaire. Elle est jalouse de sa voisine de palier, Saffron, qui est quant à elle une ancienne enfant star. Les deux femmes, souffrent de troubles obsessionnels à des degrés différents, elles vont confronter leurs univers intimes dans une bataille de volontés face à leurs troubles alimentaires et sexuels.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Vampires
programme.desc: Un savant met au point un sérum capable de transformer les humains en vampire. Une des victimes résiste au sérum et tente d'arrêter le savant et ses acolytes avant qu'il ne contamine le monde.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: Ghost bastards
programme.desc: En octobre 2012, une vidéo est retrouvée au domicile de Malcolm Johnson et les enregistrements restent inexpliqués. Après ce prologue, l'histoire se déroule sous forme de flashback. Durant l'été 2012, Malcolm et Kisha emménagent ensemble et commencent une vie heureuse. Une nuit, Kisha remarque quelques phénomènes inexpliqués qui la convainquent que leur maison est hantée par des fantômes. Pour la rassurer, Malcolm engage une équipe de tournage pour filmer l'intérieur de la maison jour et nuit. Quelques nuits plus tard, Malcolm et Kisha ont des relations sexuelles devant la caméra, malgré les protestations de Kisha. En visionnant la vidéo le lendemain, ils remarquent plusieurs phénomènes paranormaux capturés sur la bande. Malcolm veut vendre la maison, mais le marché immobilier est lent. Il décide donc d'engager un médium pour enquêter. Après que Kisha avoue avoir conclu un pacte avec le diable pour une paire de chaussures, certaines choses commencent à s'expliquer, mais cela ne résout pas les problèmes causés par les phénomènes paranormaux.

programme.title: Terreur sur la lagune
programme.desc: Le corps d'une écolière est retrouvé dans une prairie. Le meurtrier n'est jamais arrêté et, des années plus tard, un jeune homme nommé Stefano retourne sur l'île et retrouve son frère, le prêtre local.

programme.title: Cooper, un amour de chien!
programme.desc: Un chien parvient à nouer des liens avec un homme bouleversé par la mort de son épouse et de ses enfants dans un accident de la route.

programme.title: Halloween Island
programme.desc: Kai, Leilani et Eddie, trois enfants que tout oppose, doivent mettre de côté leurs différences pour sauver Hawaï d'un terrible démon légendaire qu'ils ont réveillé par erreur. Face aux plus grands dangers, les enfants vont comprendre ce que sont le courage, l'amitié et les traditions.

programme.title: Ghoster : le fantôme aux miroirs
programme.desc: Une jeune fille et son père doivent percer les secrets du manoir d'Echoville qui retient captif l'esprit le plus mignon du monde, Ghoster, depuis 50 ans, avant que le dragon fantôme ne les anéantisse tous dans sa quête d'immortalité.

programme.title: Rex, chien pompier
programme.desc: Le chien le plus choyé d'Hollywood s'égare lors d'un tournage publicitaire et devient la mascotte d'une caserne de pompiers locale.

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.sub-title: S1:E16 Le bonheur est dans le ranch
programme.desc: S1:E16 Le bonheur est dans le ranch - Bernie rend visite à ses cousins à la campagne. Corneil a insisté pour l'accompagner : c'est l'occasion de découvrir le monde rural. Mais à la campagne, les us et coutumes sont bien différents ! Pour gagner sa croûte, Corneil va devoir affronter un dangereux coyote.

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E17 Une vie de chien - La vie des chiens est loin d'être enviable. Corneil en fait la douloureuse expérience lorsque Madame Solo lui assène un coup de parapluie. Bien décidé à obtenir des excuses, Corneil décide de traîner en justice son agresseur. Il n'a d'autre choix que d'engager Bernie comme avocat…

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E18 Double jeu - Corneil est en danger ! Bernie jure que Mme Martin, la principale du lycée, possède une cassette vidéo sur laquelle on voit Corneil parler ! Corneil va devoir récupérer coûte que coûte cette preuve pour préserver son secret. Mais ce que Corneil ignore, c'est que Bernie lui a menti…

programme.title: Corneil & Bernie
programme.desc: S1:E19 Le casse-pieds - Bernie est fou de joie. La charmante Julie a accepté de l'accompagner au bal de l'école. Il ne raterait cette soirée pour rien au monde. Pas même à cause d'une jambe plâtrée. Pour sauver l'idylle de Bernie, Corneil décide de s'inviter au bal…

programme.title: Hierarchy : Braquage au sommet
programme.desc: Deux frères adoptifs s'apprêtent à réaliser le braquage le plus risqué de leur vie, un coup qui pourrait les libérer à jamais. Mais traqués par une mafia impitoyable et une police prête à tout pour les arrêter, ils devront choisir entre la fuite, la loyauté… ou la survie.

programme.title: L'Ingénieur
programme.desc: D'après une histoire vraie. Yahya Ayyash, surnommé "l'ingénieur", organise des vagues d'attentats-suicides en Israël au milieu des années 1990. La plus grande des chasses à l'homme de l'histoire du pays se met en place pour le retrouver.

programme.title: Paradise Cove : Cauchemar à Malibu
programme.desc: Knox vient d'hériter de la superbe villa de sa mère à Malibu et décide de la retaper pour s'y installer avec sa femme Tracey. La vue est incroyable et le site semble avoir tout du paradis. C'est sans compter sur une mystérieuse sans-abri, Bree, qui s'est accaparé le sous-sol de la maison et qui va devenir leur pire cauchemar...

programme.title: Diamonds War
programme.desc: Un ancien combattant de MMA et ses frères doivent sauver leur famille kidnappée d'un dangereux syndicat du crime après le vol de 50 millions de dollars de diamants issus de trafics.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer
programme.desc: Un mystérieux tueur élimine les plus grands maîtres en arts martiaux, laissant derrière lui une arme secrète comme signature. Lorsqu'un expert en kung-fu emprisonné reconnaît la technique utilisée, il conclut un marché avec la police : aider à traquer le meurtrier en échange de sa liberté.

programme.title: Miniyamba
programme.desc: Comme des dizaines de milliers de personnes qui chaque jour dans le monde quittent leur terre natale, Abdu, un jeune malien, a décidé de gagner l'Europe. Un voyage du fleuve niger aux barbelés de l'enclave de Ceuta, où les rêves se confrontent à la dure réalité des migrants, avec au loin les lumières de l'occident.

programme.title: Je suis fan de mon voisin
programme.desc: Georges vie sa vie tranquillement, sans savoir que son voisin l'imite...

programme.title: Blanche
programme.desc: Un homme part de la vallée, pour aller chercher des glaciers, des sommets. Il fuit un monde bruyant, polluant. Un monde qui fait fondre les glaciers, qui les réchauffent et les fait disparaître. Il monte, s'éloigne et toujours, pourtant, il sait que le monde d'en bas le poursuit.

programme.title: Papa dans maman
programme.desc: Milieu de la nuit. Des gémissements se font entendre derrière la porte des parents. Deux jeunes soeurs s'interrogent...

programme.title: Le quepa sur la vilni !
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, André sort de sa paisible retraite . Sur ordre du maire, il doit mener à travers monts une troupe d'hommes-sandwichs à vélo pour attirer les spectateurs à l'inauguration du cinéma local.

programme.title: Spotted
programme.desc: Un fugitif se fait intercepter par deux douaniers crapuleux alors qu'il tentait d'échapperà son destin. Au cours d'un interrogatoire musclé, Big Mike et son sous-fifre s'efforcent de démenteler son réseau clandestin et de mettre fin à ses rêves de liberté.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: Dans le nez
programme.desc: “Dans le nez” est une histoire d'amour, de dégoût et de chimie volatile. Un conte où les montagnes sont des flacons, les aisselles des sources et les fantômes des parfums.

programme.title: Braise
programme.desc: Lors d'une soirée bien arrosée, un jeune homme trompe sa copine avec une jolie et exubérante Anglaise. Trois de leurs amis observent et commentent cette aventure. Un parallèle se crée entre cette conversation et l'étreinte des deux amants.

programme.title: L'amour libre
programme.desc: Dans un café parisien, deux bonnes amies, l'une célibataire et l'autre en union libre, se réunissent pour faire le point sur leur vie et leurs amours.

programme.title: Papa oom mow mow
programme.desc: Rouen, 1986. Par ennui, par amour, par opportunité (ou par miracle), Frank subit un choc capillaire, qui change sa triste vie dans sa pluvieuse ville...

programme.title: Tous les garçons aiment ça
programme.desc: Un adolescent retrouve sa copine pour le week-end. Ils ont décidé de faire l'amour. Les parents sont absents et rien ne devrait empêcher leur première fois. Enfin, si l'on est dans un teenage movie...

programme.title: Flow
programme.desc: John, un jeune bodybuilder, se prépare jour après jour pour une compétition, les NPC Georgia Bodybulding Championships. Sa vie est un rituel, une mécanique parfaitement réglée. Concentré sur son objectif, il ne lâche rien, espérant atteindre sur scène cet instant de bonheur unique : le flow.

programme.title: La femme à cordes
programme.desc: Sébastien, un jeune homme d'une vingtaine d'années, entre dans un petit théâtre sur les conseils d'un inconnu. Gogol l'invite à regarder son show. Ce dernier s'amuse à malmener une femme devant un parterre médusé. Sébastien s'interpose, sans connaître les règles du jeu.

programme.title: On the road...
programme.desc: « On the road to paradise » raconte la rencontre improbable dans un restoroute d'une serveuse au bord de la crise de nerfs, d'un camionneur collectionneur de routiers et d'une jeune femme en pleine rupture amoureuse. Tous les trois partagent sans le savoir, le même secret : ils viennent d'assassiner un homme. Un policier entre alors dans le restaurant...

programme.title: Flesh
programme.desc: L'Empire dévoile tout mais ne voit rien. Ses ennemis idéalisent tout mais ne tolèrent rien. L'orgasme terrestre des putains cathodiques pour les uns. L'orgasme éternel des 70 vierges paradisiaques pour les autres. Et si la chair était seule au monde ?

programme.title: Goût bacon
programme.desc: À la suite d'une rumeur lancée à cause de la diffusion d'un snapchat au contenu ambigu, deux amis, Bilal et Adil, se mettent en quête de filles pour sauver leur réputation. Mais le chemin est loin d'être celui qu'ils avaient imaginé…

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: La virée à Paname
programme.desc: Mourad, vingt ans, vivote entre cours de théâtre, sorties entre potes et petite copine. Ce jour-là, il décide de quitter son quartier pour se rendre à un atelier d'écriture, à Paris. Mais la démarche va s'avérer plus compliquée que prévu.

programme.title: Retrosexe
programme.desc: 2065.Persuadés que le sexe c'était mieux avant, une bande d'adolescents part sur les traces du Retrosexe.

programme.title: American Ninja 5
programme.desc: Lorsque la fille d'un scientifique est kidnappée, American Ninja (David Bradley) tente de la retrouver, mais cette fois-ci, il fait équipe avec un jeune qu'il a formé aux techniques du ninja.

programme.title: The Agent
programme.desc: Jong-seong, un agent fantôme nord-coréen, interrompt une vente d'armes illégale à Berlin. Un agent nord-coréen notoire met à l'épreuve la loyauté de tous les participants alors que Jong-seong se prépare à faire le sacrifice ultime.

programme.title: GANGNAM ZOMBIES
programme.desc: Des citoyens du quartier huppé de Gangnam à Séoul commencent à présenter des symptômes inhabituels et terrifiants, se transformant en créatures inhumaines, ne laissant que quelques survivants avec une chance de s'en sortir vivants.

programme.title: It Came From The Desert
programme.desc: Les fourmis sont les véritables vedettes de ce buddy-movie qui rend un hommage direct aux films de monstres des années 50. Inspiré du cultissime jeu vidéo des années 80 It came from the desert ce film déjanté est un fabuleux mélange de fourmis géantes et de courses de moto dans le désert… Nouveau Mexique - Se rendant à une Keg Party où la bière coule à flots nos 2 coureurs de motocross vont faire une rencontre inattendue en tombant par hasard sur un ancien site militaire. Des expérimentations secrètes visant à croiser leur l'ADN avec des débris d'une métérorite trouvée en 1951 ont été menées sur des fourmis et araignées….et qui ont donné naissance à des fourmis géantes mutantes !

programme.title: Pets To The Rescue
programme.desc: Lorsque un frère et une sœur sont enlevés après avoir trouvé un camion d'or volé, ce sont leurs animaux de compagnie qui doivent prendre les choses en main pour les sauver !

programme.title: The Sherlock Holmes: Valley Of Fear
programme.desc: Un violoniste introverti et fumeur rencontre un médecin et le plonge dans le monde criminel.

programme.title: 6 Below : Miracle On The Mountain
programme.desc: D'après une histoire vraie, l'aventure de l'athlète Eric LeMarque, qui se perd en snowboard lors d'une puissante tempête. Il a survécu huit jours sans aucune aide, et alors qu'il était en plein sevrage d'une addiction à la drogue.

programme.title: 21 And Over
programme.desc: Deux jeunes amis emmènent un de leurs camarades, qui célèbre ses 21 ans, dans une grande fête de carabins. Mais quand une bière en débouche sur une autre, la soirée tourne à la débauche. Personne n'est prêt d'oublier les événements pathétiques qui vont en découler…

programme.title: Dangerous Intentions
programme.desc: Depuis des années, Beth Williamson supporte le comportement extrêmement violent de son mari Tim. Elle cache la terrible réalité à sa famille ainsi qu'à ses amis, mais surtout à sa fille Laurie. Un jour, elle décide de prendre sa vie en main et retourne chez sa mère. Emprisonné puis relâché, Tim a juré de se venger. Entre temps Beth rencontre Kaye, elle aussi victime de violence conjugale. Les deux amies prennent une maison ensemble en espérant que la vie va enfin commencer pour elles et leurs enfants...

programme.title: Paranoïa (2018)
programme.desc: Une jeune femme, convaincue d'être harcelée, est enfermée contre son gré dans une institution psychiatrique. Alors même qu'elle tente de convaincre tout le monde qu'elle est en danger, elle commence à se demander si sa peur est fondée ou le fruit de son imagination.

programme.title: Stratton
programme.desc: Stratton, agent du MI6, s'infiltre avec son coéquipier Marty dans un laboratoire iranien pour intercepter le vol de molécules chimiques mortelles. Mais à leur arrivée, celles-ci ont déjà disparu et la mission tourne mal…

programme.title: Inheritance
programme.desc: À la mort de sa mère, Maya retrouve son père à New York. Celui-ci l'emmène au Caire, où il est alors enlevé.

programme.title: La maison aux esprits
programme.desc: Basé sur le roman à succès d'Isabel Allende, La Maison des esprits est une épopée romantique envoûtante couvrant trois générations de la famille Trueba.

programme.title: The Gate
programme.desc: Un arbre est enlevé du jardin de Glen et révèle un mystérieux trou qui mène à un portail et la chambre souterraine d'un mal terrifiant.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Un homme essaie de se débarrasser de visions horribles et commence à soupçonner que ce qu'il voit sont de sombres souvenirs d'enfance.

programme.title: Les messagers
programme.desc: Une famille quitte la ville animée de Chicago en faveur d'une nouvelle vie dans une ferme de tournesols isolée. Mais leur nouveau départ vire rapidement au cauchemar lorsqu'une série d'étranges événements les poussent à croire qu'ils ne sont pas seuls dans leur nouvelle maison.

programme.title: The Gate
programme.desc: Un arbre est enlevé du jardin de Glen et révèle un mystérieux trou qui mène à un portail et la chambre souterraine d'un mal terrifiant.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Un homme essaie de se débarrasser de visions horribles et commence à soupçonner que ce qu'il voit sont de sombres souvenirs d'enfance.

programme.title: Criminals
programme.desc: Différentes actions menées dans la ville de Londres, à notre époque, contre le milieu violent du traffic d'armes.

programme.title: Battle for Skyark
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, la Terre est devenue un endroit désolé et hostile. Menacée par une mystérieuse race de monstres, l'humanité a été forcée de se réfugier sur Sky Ark, une ville construite dans le ciel.

programme.title: Usurpation
programme.desc: Brian mène une vie paisible avec sa femme Angela et leur fille. Leur quotidien bascule lorsqu'Angela échappe de peu à un accident mortel, et que des objets disparaissent de leur maison. Brian découvre que leur nouvelle amie cache un secret dangereux.

programme.title: The Adventurers
programme.desc: Le célèbre voleur Cheung Tan a récemment été libéré de prison. Juste après sa libération, avec ses acolytes Xiao Bao et Ye Hong, il planifie de voler des bijoux précieux en Europe.

programme.desc: Gaffes, erreurs, ratés, Michel et Michel vous disent tout sur vos films et séries préférés.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez joue le rôle d'une fille ordinaire dont le voyage d'été à Paris se transforme en rêve de sa vie lorsqu'elle devient une princesse accidentelle en assumant l'identité d'une autre personne.

programme.title: Coup de Foudre à Oxford
programme.desc: Caro Drake, émotionnellement gardée, arrive à Oxford avec le seul objectif d'obtenir son doctorat, mais à travers une amitié turbulente avec un charmant jeune homme, Caro commence à s'ouvrir au mystère des nouvelles expériences, à la vulnérabilité et à l'amour.

programme.title: Ne serait-ce que
programme.desc: Une tragédie apprend au jeune homme d'affaires anglais Ian Wyndham à faire passer l'amour avant le travail. Il apprend enfin à s'ouvrir à sa petite amie Samantha Andrews.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Prêt à tout pour trouver un sujet d'article intéressant, un journaliste suit une prostituée diplômée de Stanford et s'introduit dans le monde des escorts girls de luxe.

programme.title: Golem, le Tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Le Londres victorien est terrorisé par un tueur en série inconnu qui laisse des messages énigmatiques écrits avec le sang de ses victimes. Lorsque les meurtres se multiplient, Scotland Yard confie l'affaire à un inspecteur célèbre.

programme.title: Un Endroit Sombre
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un jeune garçon disparaît dans une petite ville tranquille, Donald, un chauffeur de camion de voirie local, se lance dans une enquête précaire et obsessionnelle, jouant les détectives.

programme.title: Le Quatrième Pouvoir
programme.desc: Un journaliste se retrouve impliqué dans un complot terroriste à Moscou alors qu'il enquête sur les services secrets russes.

programme.title: A Magic Puppy
programme.desc: Adam, qui adore Halloween, transforme accidentellement le petit ami de sa mère en chien.

programme.title: Bernie le Dauphin: Mission Sauvetage
programme.desc: Un frère et une soeur découvrent sur la plage un dauphin brûlé par le soleil et décident de le soigner.

programme.title: Kids In America
programme.desc: Un groupe divers d'élèves s'unit pour défier pacifiquement leur principal autoritaire.

programme.title: Horatio, un Ami Extraordinaire
programme.desc: Depuis la mort de son père, Juliette, sa belle-mère et ses deux demi-frères peinent à garder leur ranch.

programme.title: Noël tous les jours
programme.desc: Sophie, productrice de télé-réalité accro au travail, tourne une émission sur Will, un homme qui célèbre Noël toute l'année. À ses côtés, elle redécouvre peu à peu la magie des fêtes.

programme.title: Les sept jours de Noël
programme.desc: Kim, une véritable accro au travail, atteint le point de rupture lorsque son petit ami la quitte sans même la demander en mariage. Sa mère l'emmène alors passer quelques jours dans un centre de vacances pour Noël afin qu'elle retrouve la magie des fêtes. Ce qu'elles ignorent, c'est que la propriétaire du centre a fait appel à Mark, le frère de Kim, récemment au chômage et qui semble partager nombre de ses travers. Parviendront-ils à dépasser leurs similitudes, qu'aucun d'eux ne veut admettre, et à laisser la magie de Noël les unir à quelque chose d'inattendu ?

programme.title: La Chanteuse amoureuse
programme.desc: Lassée d'une vie contrôlée par son entourage, une popstar rêve de normalité. Entre son ex-mari célèbre, son manager autoritaire et un disquaire sincère, elle doit enfin choisir sa propre voie.

programme.title: Un amour de photographe
programme.desc: Laura, assistante de galerie passionnée de photo, doit convaincre Shane, un artiste retiré du monde depuis dix ans, d'exposer ses clichés. En l'aidant à retrouver l'inspiration, elle pourrait aussi trouver sa propre voie.

programme.title: Une manucure parfaite
programme.desc: Katya, inventrice originale, s'associe à Ryan, consultant charismatique, pour présenter son invention au salon de la beauté. Entre tensions, ambitions et romance, leur partenariat devient explosif.

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Associes
programme.desc: Les choses tournent mal quand un gros dur inspecteur de police monte un poste de surveillance chez les Robberson, qui vivent juste à côté de chez un tueur à gages de la mafia.

programme.title: Potins De Femmes

La mariée s'appelle Shelby (Julia Roberts), une belle jeune femme têtue dont la mère très stricte, M'Lynn (Sally Field), est prête à tout pour elle. Dolly Parton à la chevelure imposante joue le rôle de Truvy, la propriétaire d'un salon de beauté qui est le centre non officiel de la ville. Parmi sa clientèle jamais en reste de potins, il y a Ouiser (Shirley MacLaine), la femme la plus riche et la plus méchante du coin, et Clairee (Olympia Dukakis), une élégante veuve plutôt sournoise. L'atmosphère s'anime avec l'arrivée d'une nouvelle jeune femme, Annelle (Daryl Hannah), une stagiaire un peu naïve avec ses lunettes de chat et son passé mystérieux. Ces six « magnolias de fer » forment un groupe de soutien et d'amitié et constituent un bon auditoire pour les blagues des unes et des autres malgré les aléas de l'existence et de l'amour dans une petite ville du sud.

programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. programme.title: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper Discuss Their Careers And Growing Up Working Class
programme.desc: Actors Daisy May and Charlie Cooper, siblings behind the hit show This Country, join Fearne Cotton to discuss how growing up working class shaped their work ethic, creativity, and resilience. They open up about the class divide, self-doubt in breaking into television, and the £350,000 contract clause that nearly prevented their show from happening.

In this chat with Fearne, live from the Happy Place Festival, Candice explains why she felt it was so important to write about big topics like medical racism and fertility pressures, as well as why for her characters come first and the plot is just a side quest.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Why We Should Abolish Politicians
programme.desc: Yale political scientist Hélène Landemore, author of Politics Without Politicians, argues that the political systems we take for granted are no longer fit for purpose. As trust in politicians reaches historic lows across Britain, Europe and the United States, Landemore makes the case that elections alone may no longer be enough to produce governments that truly represent ordinary people.

Hasan was due to meet Corbyn, the former leader of the Labour Party, but the UK government revoked his and his uncle Cenk Uygur's e-visas, claiming their arrival would not be "conducive to the public good." programme.title: Wizard of Oz Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has created countless classic wedding themes in his career as a wedding planner, but his latest bride Aime Simmons and her “Wizard of Oz” themed wedding has David ready to click his heels together and wish for home. From the poinsettia centerpieces to the giant lollipops to the construction paper yellow brick road Aime wants to walk down, David has his work cut out for him. He upgrades Aime's wedding dress to a gorgeous bridal gown, complete with genuine ruby slippers and takes her bridesmaids out of their munchin-themed outfits, putting them into stunning, elegant dresses fit for a trip to the emerald city. With so many great changes and not enough room in Aime's venue, David moves the wedding's location to a picturesque California mountain ranch. Just when Aime thinks David is done surprising her, he reveals his final one: an afternoon trip that will really test the bride's courage!

programme.title: Safari Bride
programme.desc: Even with his history of creating the most amazing and beautiful weddings, David Tutera sometimes runs into brides who can't trust him and let go of the work they've already put into their weddings. Such is the case with David's newest bridge, Shelby Ellis of Orange, California. With her own design background and dreams of going into event and wedding planning herself, Shelby was hoping that her wedding day would be perfect. But Shelby has gone wild with her “Passport to Africa” theme by choosing the wrong dress, booking a ceremony space that doesn't fit the theme, and covered everything in zebra stripes. She's put it on her table accessories, on the groom's tie, and even the bridesmaid's dresses! David has got plenty to do, but finds that Shelby is resistant every change he makes. Can David convince his bride to trust him and still have the time to put on a majestic and elegant wedding in only 3 weeks?

programme.title: Breast Cancer Survivor Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera's always gets to know his brides when trying to give them the wedding day of their dreams. When he meets bride Kimberly Read, a breast cancer survivor, David is touched by her story, and dedicates himself to making sure Kimberly's inspirational story comes through in her wedding. Kimberly's theme, 1950's Havana, present David with plenty of challenges on its own, but Kimberly's hope to include breast cancer awareness into the theme gives David an even bigger set of hurdles. David replaces Kimberly's standard dress with an incredible and fantastic gown that has the Cuban flair she's looking for, and takes her bridesmaids out of their plan dresses and puts them into sultry, sexy, and classy gowns straight out of Havana. David's not done with the surprises, though. He enlists a little bit of help from the people who know and love Kimberly the most for an unforgettable and emotional wedding day surprise.

programme.title: Mini-truck Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera always makes sure his weddings tell the story of the bride and groom, incorporating not just their lives together, but any common interests they may have. His new bride Michelle may have taken things too far when trying to work in the hobby she shares with fiancé Josh: mini-trucks. After Michelle shows David what she's put together: mini license plates and toy cars for the reception tables, bridesmaids in dresses out of their own closets, and a wedding dress even she doesn't like, David faces a tough challenge. David gives her the exquisite bridal gown of her dreams, puts her bridesmaids in elegant matching dresses, and even uses her love of trucks into a rehearsal for an important wedding day moment. On Michelle's wedding day, David uses her mini-truck theme to create and amazing, elegant, yet fun reception hall she'll never forget!

programme.title: Winter Wonderland Bride
programme.desc: When it comes to making dream weddings come true, there's no one better than David Tutera. But when he meets his newest bride, Amber, her vision looks more like a nightmare than a dream! She has her heart set on getting married in a snowy winter wonderland, despite the fact that she lives in Southern California. And that's not all: she also wants to work in tributes to both her Indonesian heritage as well as her husband's last name: Ace. When Amber shows David what she has planned: Christmas flowers and decorations as centerpieces, wooden Indonesian statues, and playing cards everywhere, he's more confused than ever. Amber's planned fashion is no better: mismatched bridesmaid dresses and a gown she borrowed from an aunt. David spends the next three weeks turning Amber's avalanche of corny into a magical Winter Wonderland straight out of a fantasy.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Healer Ep.14 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "It's okay to cry" After confirming Yeongjae's death, Jeonghu loses it and runs away. After hearing his master's final words, Jeonghu hides from the world, and Yeongsin is desperate to find him. Then, a mysterious person comes to her...

programme.title: Healer Ep.15 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "We remember you" Jeonghu wants to be himself when he is with Yeongsin. When Jeonghu comes to him, Munho proposes the fathers' method to Jeonghu and Munho, Jeonghu and Yeongsin's counterattack begins. However, after receiving Munho's declaration of war, Munsik covertly approaches Yeongsin...

programme.title: Healer Ep.16 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "Back to you" Once Jeonghu begins to investigate his father's case, the team ordered by the Elder begins to take action. Munsik plants seeds of suspicion into Yeongsin, and Munho decides to tell her the truth before Munsik could do it. Yeongsin is in shock when she hears the secret Munho and Jeonghu had been keeping from her. Jeonghu chases the truth about his father in order to go back to Yeongsin, but...

programme.title: Healer Ep.17 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "Will you answer me?" Without having a chance to clear up Yeongsin's misunderstanding, Jeonghu continues investigating what happened to his father. Boss' special team is on Jeonghu's tail to cover up the truth he uncovers. Yeongsin visits Myeonghui to find her truth as well, and ends up seeing Jeonghu there. Those under Munho come together and their operation begins...

programme.title: Healer Ep.18 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "Like ordinary people" The truth of what happened that fateful day is finally exposed, thanks to the tape of Junseok's testimony. Jeonghu decides to stay by Yeongsin's side, and live like ordinary people. The first step of living an average life is meeting his girlfriend's father. However, Munho continues his attack on Boss, who was also exposed along with the truth about Junseok, and Someday falls under attack.

programme.title: Healer Ep.19 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "I'll protect you" Boss uses the same tactic he used on Munsik to own Jeonghu, but Jeonghu bets on himself and leaves Yeongsin to face off against him. Munho and Someday News do not give in to his threats and continue to report on Boss' identity. However, Minja, who has been helping Jeonghu, ends up being tracked by Munsik's cyber team...

programme.title: Healer Ep.20 (English Dub)
programme.desc: "Goodbye, Healer" Boss uses Yeongsin's and Munho's weaknesses to continue threatening them, and Jeonghu feels his limitations in fighting him alone. Minja gathers everyone together, and Munho and Yeongsin prepare a retaliation interview. The day before the big day, Jeonghu prepares a gift for Yeongsin and makes a final decision for the welfare of everyone else.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.7
programme.desc: "Seoyeong visits her mother's hometown to bury her ashes and runs into Ujae who secretly followed her. Meanwhile Hojeong continues to do what she can to try and get Sangu's attention whilst Seoyeong's dad runs into trouble again and his daughter finally confronts him about why she hates him. In the end Ujae's mother discovers the photos that Ujae took of Seoyeong and the family go into an interrogation about Seoyeong's background. The heartbreaking and ardent love of Lee Sam-jae, Seo-young's father, for his daughter is depicted in this weekend drama, highlighting the preciousness of parental love. It teaches us that family is interconnected not only by blood but also by love."

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.8
programme.desc: Samjae continues to work hard as a hall manager to save money and face but ends up at the police station much to Seoyeong's disappointment. Hojeong gets busted for being in love which will lead to dire consequences for her. Seongjae finds out what's been going on with his brother and his tutor and why she has to quit. He relieves his stress the only way he knows how... Which is to go on a shopping spree... Just like his mother. Migyeong finds out the truth behind her boyfriend and Ujae gives up on Seoyeong in the end.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.9
programme.desc: Ujae's mother goes on a hunger strike to try and prevent Ujae's marriage but in the end she strikes a deal that forces Seoyeong to back away. Ujae's at his wits end because he's done everything he can to win Seoyeong's heart. He knows she loves him and her pride and fear are keeping her away. In the end he decides that he can't do anything for her and leaves for the U.S. Meanwhile Hojeong tried desperately to meet Sangu one last time to return his handkerchief only to discover that his father's sick. She ends up nursing him and gets to see Sangu who confirms that he doesn't like her but doesn't hate her either. This is good enough for her.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.10
programme.desc: Seoyeong is determined to maintain her lie about going overseas. There is no way she can confess to Ujae that she lied about her father. Sangu is distraught at her decision but can't help her out. There is no way that he can disown his father no matter how much he has hated him too. In the midst of this Hojeong agrees to go to the U.S. with the promise that after she returns she can do whatever she wants. In the end Samjae goes to be a pretend guest at a VIP's wedding... The twist is shocking!

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.11
programme.desc: It's been 3 years since the last episode... Jiseon has a hard time adjusting to her perfect daughter-in-law... What every other mother-in-law would be happy about, she finds a burden and complains to Gapsun. Meanwhile Hojeong returns from the U.S., bringing back a man with her that she's sure her mother will accept. Migyeong is now dating Sangu and considering marriage whilst Seoyeong has to handle a major case and continues to grow weary of being a judge. Samjae is the one who is truly doing well with himself, having paid of his debts and worked hard to become a decent father. Perhaps he hopes for the day he'll be reunited with his daughter.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.12
programme.desc: Marriage troubles continue between Ujae's parents as their wedding anniversary comes by. Seoyeong gets scouted by Unique Law Firm after the sentencing of her murder trial. She finds it harder by the day to work as a judge. Meanwhile Samjae is continuing to work hard and Sangu's love for Migyeong is deepening. She's worried about telling him the truth whilst Hojeong does what she can to gain some independence from her overly attached mother.

programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.6
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: The Power of Plants Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation – a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Our ideas about plants need a seed change – it's time to respect the power of plants.

programme.title: The Power of Plants The Great Escape
programme.desc: You think plants are boring or passive? Far from it! They use complex reactions to respond to light, sound and touch. And like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Plants have evolved tricks to beat the ele-ments, animal enemies or even other plants: From thorns and spines to poisons and even live-in bodyguards. This two-part series shows the survival strategies of our green “roommates” we share the planet with.

programme.title: Hidden Australia
programme.desc: Sometimes called the biggest island on Earth, Australia is a sub-continent of incredible diversity, beauty, danger and downright weirdness. The 4,000km between the coasts are made up of a patchwork of contrasting landscapes: tropical rainforests, snow-capped mountains, dry woodland, giant wetlands, tropical reefs and hostile desert. These vast tracts of wilderness boast the world's most unique and bizarre wildlife communities. In this ‘hidden' Australia, there is an astonishing surprise at every turn.

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The palm tree laden beaches on Mexico's Riviera Maya on the Yucatan peninsula are endless, and the turquoise sea with its gentle Caribbean surf is a warm 25 degrees during the mild winter in this part of the world. Between Cancún and Punta Allen, where once there was little more than bushland and a few sleepy fishing villages, vibrant life has evolved during the past three decades. Richard Sowa has lived on a floating island for the past 15 years: an island he built himself out of empty plastic bottles. The bon vivant him-self sees it as a "solution for our planet's refuse problem". Off Punta Allen, a village in the bay of Sian Ka'an, Mexican Mara Coral Ley and her cousin Kim, continue to catch lobsters by adhering to the traditional method and were awarded an "Eco seal for sustainable fishing" for their trouble. It is silent under water off Isla Mujeres and it is here that the artist Jason deCaires has constructed a sculpture park. Hundreds of lifesize figures form an artificial reef at a depth of 12 metres. Fish and plants complete his work of art. The master himself is convinced: "Mother Nature is the true artist".

programme.title: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest on earth and didn't evolve until after the last Ice Age. It seems so familiar, yet offers many surprises. The shores of the Baltic Sea are still shaped by wind and waves. The first episode takes us from Denmark's northernmost corner, via the Darss Peninsula in Germany and Lithuania's Curonian Spit to the endless beaches of Latvia. The film begins at the gateway to the Baltic Sea at Denmark's northernmost point: Skagen. It is here that the North Sea and the Baltic Sea meet and form a divide made of sand between Skagerrak and Kattegat. In June, hundreds of seals gather together on the lonely island of Anholt between Denmark and Sweden. It is the largest seal colony in the Baltic Sea. No camera team has ever been able to get so close to the animals as nature filmmaker Christoph Hauschild. Using remote-control cameras, he and his team have been able to capture intimate images of the way the seals live over and beneath water. For the very first time they follow a mother with her young to swimming lessons and in doing so, capture very emotional moments of these timid creatures. Most of the freshwater from the North Sea to the Baltic Sea, flows through the Store Baelt. In this sound, the underwater world is characterised by many species of saltwater loving fish. In the waters around Sjaelland, the largest stocks of harbour porpoise in the Baltic Sea. In 2016, the labyrinth of islands, sounds and fjords attracted two dolphins. They spent several months in the fjords of Flensburg and Kiel. Astounding images: they show familiar to us from the Mediterranean, but not something we would necessarily expect from the Baltic Sea.

programme.title: To the South

They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The day has finally arrived! Mark and the Ghoulz have officially completed the restoration of Cindy D'Agostino's 1970 Challenger R/T 440, in her favorite Mopar color: FC7 Plum Crazy! We all know how crazy Tony D'Agostino can get when it comes to detailed restorations, but how will his wife Cindy react to her newest purple Challenger? After all, she does call herself the Plum Crazy Wife!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Adding to GYC's growing list of epic Dodge Charger restorations, Mark and Justin begin the final assembly of an all numbers matching, 1969 Charger R/T SE, 440 Magnum, 4-Speed! But, when Will gets too cocky and disrespects Mark in front of the crew, the guns come out - the paint guns! Mark challenges Will to yet another, mano-a-mano paint-off!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Doug disassembles and dissects parts from a rare and well documented 1970 Challenger convertible that cannot be restored. Prompting Mark to admit the horrible truth, that not all cars can be saved. Although they can't save everything, they can resurrect memories by creating a tribute 1971 Challenger R/T, 440 Six Pack, in Hemi Orange! Will is ready to spray his custom EV2 formula, that is, if Mark will stop interrupting him with movie references.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: While Justin assembles the interior of our 1969 Charger R/T Special Edition, Mark and Doug complete the build of a 1966 Hemi. This 426 Hemi is connected to a 4 speed manual transmission, sitting in a rarely seen 1966 Dodge Charger. Even rarer, is the Charger's ZZ1 Gold Poly paint. Mark employs the fork-lift for maximum maneuverability of this massive engine, while Doug guides it past the pristine Poly paint. Doug's first Hemi install in a '66 Charger is bound to be memorable!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Running out of options, Will finally gets a new helper in the paint booth. But, his decades old habit may drive Will crazy. Mark and Tony do a deep-dive dissection of a Dodge Demon. Breaking down this very unique, 1971, Hemi Orange, 340, that could be only one of one ever made! Finally, Tony and Mark evaluate a beautiful 1970 Challenger R/T, 440 6 Pack, 4-speed, convertible! Rare, gorgeous, and one of Mark's favorite cars in the queue!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: A phantasm from Mark's past reaches out from the grave, prompting a road trip to acquire one of Mark's favorite cars! For Mark G. Worman, there is no better holiday to celebrate at the Graveyard than Halloween! Which is great for his cousin Dougie, who loves Halloween but not so great for Will and Allysa. Although they're more than familiar with Mark's Halloween antics, this year's celebration may have them reaching for a stake and a hammer!

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Ghoulz lay out and buff a beautiful paint job on Christine, and tease the remarkable rebirth of this movie-correct car! Justin forges ahead with the final assembly of the 1970 Tor Red roadrunner convertible and Mark demonstrates one of Mopar's mechanical masterpieces: the Air Grabber hood. Meanwhile, just when Will and Brody think it's safe to go back in the paint booth, Mark's out for blood! But will Mark's razor-sharp remarks and biting humor halt progress on the very unique 1971 roadrunner?

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The black 1971 Hemi 'Cuda tribute build is almost a roller! Will and his team are assembling the newly painted metal while Doug trains some new blood on assembling the remaining pieces of the 'Cuda's drivetrain. Meanwhile, Mark tests his daughter's Mopar expertise with a car that may or may not be carrying fake ID! Another rare 'Cuda that Mark and Allysa must dissect, detect, and do a deep dive to discover its actual provenance.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. The fib snowballs when the Queen of Berryvania reads Apple's review and orders Strawberry's new cake for her ball.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Sour teasing Apple escalates into a "prank war" between the two of them. Miraculously, they emerge best buds, and their friends are relieved, until Sour's influence on Apple turns her into a mini-Sour, and they have to do a personality "makeover" on Apple.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berrykin Bloom's braggart cousin, Berrykin Bertram, has won the hot sauce competition at the local county fair year after year.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Spooky Sensation
programme.desc: The girls decided to spend a weekend at the hotel. It appears to be haunted. Watch the full video to know more about this.

programme.title: Sings of Love
programme.desc: See how Stephanie and Olivia enter the Under the Sea photo competition. Jacob wrote a love song! Olivia and her friends are very excited to hear. Tanya and Stephanie are teamed up in baking class. Watch the video for more fun.

programme.title: Video Wonder
programme.desc: Olivia and Andrea visited science camp with Mrs Stevens. On the other hand, Andrea and Mia decides to return a lost skunk to nature. Andrea was reading intimate postcards between Chef Pierre and Mrs. Stevens.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.
